title: The Landfall of Patagonia's dry side
author: Rosalind Almeida
blurb: Paloma Dunmore, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
